description:
STEP 6 (final): after the core is on the new major and the add-ons are re-installed
    (addon_port_prepare + install), re-attach the preserved data and PROVE zero loss. Restores the
    own-model + m2m tables byte-exact (truncate + reload the snapshot, ids preserved) and re-applies
    the inherited-field values via the ORM, then recomputes every baseline metric and diffs it -
    returns ZERO_DATA_LOSS_ALL_MATCH or the exact discrepancies. dry_run previews; confirm runs.
    Preview-gated. Requires a prior addon_data_snapshot.
name: addon_data_restore
